summary: Branch autoreview converged over many rounds. Setup-pause approvals settle through the existing durable interaction machinery (dedup, restart recovery, persist->recheck) with a single fingerprint fence; setup cards report the real triggering source and outcome; provider affordance parity and delivery-callback fan-out are covered. Bespoke lease/claim protocols were removed in favor of the shared path. Remaining item is a documented cross-aggregate-transaction boundary (D-0046), not a code-quality defect.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Setup fence and persistent grant are not atomic (job-state/permission TOCTOU) — deferred D-0046; user-revocable worst case.

residual_risks: D-0044: stale-lease card retirement across process death needs a durable run->card identity (best-effort today).
D-0045: strict receipt-before-output ordering needs a durable outbox (informational receipt today).
D-0046: setup-fence/grant atomicity needs a cross-repository transaction (user-revocable TOCTOU today).
recommendation: Land; residuals are bounded, non-escalation, user-revocable, and tracked as deferrals.
